title: Forward Cobblemon
body:
# Forward Cobblemon 1.21.1 - 1.6
Explore the vast world of Minecraft and Pokemon together. Forward Cobblemon brings a close to vanilla Minecraft experience to Cobblemon. No fancy spawns, shops and no pay to win mechanics (not even vote crates). 

# Why so basic?
This server was created because I really enjoyed Pixelmon (now Cobblemon) however my friend didn't and just wanted to play Minecraft which I got bored of real quick. This is how Forward Cobblemon was born, enough features to keep the Pokemon fans happy but staying true to Minecraft to keep your friends entertained.
